maria: Kicking off onboarding for kodiak-8b (8B) int4 experiment. Goal: validate quality vs current baseline (ember21b) and wire up rollout paths for hosted / dedicated / private.

sasha: Nice — can you drop the minimal checklist here so eng/platform and oncall know expectations?

maria: Yup. High level plan: tri-phase activation -> 1) quant smoke + evals, 2) staged traffic canary, 3) fallback + metrics gating. Short checklist below.

maria: ```
PHASE 0 - PREP
- model artifact hash + provenance
- quant artifacts (int4) + conversion logs
- size/kvcache estimates for 128/2048 contexts
- perf baseline on representative infra (p99, throughput)

PHASE 1 - QUANT SMOKE
- run eval suite: unit tests + regen on eval dataset (10k prompts)
- quality delta threshold: top-1 exact match <= 3% for pass, manual review if 3-7%
- perf: token/s and p95 latency on dedicated shard

PHASE 2 - STAGED CANARY
- 1% hosted traffic -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% with 24h holds
- A/B metrics: latency, error rate, cost/token, hallucination rate (eval hooks)
- automatic rollback triggers: >2x error rate or >5% quality regression

PHASE 3 - PRIVATE/Dedicated ONBOARD
- infra validation in VPC (KMS keys present)
- regional fallback configured to ember21b equivalent
- SLA smoke & long-tail latency tests
```

liam: Couple clarifications: what are the exact abort gates for the quant smoke? who owns the manual QA signoff?

maria: Abort gates: fail eval or perf p95 > 2x baseline. Manual QA: @sasha owns initial pass, @tom will escalate for product-level checks.

sasha: I can take QA window. I'll schedule a 2-hour slot after PHASE 1 finishes to eyeball 200 failing/near-fail prompts.

tom: For hosted canary we need routing policy entries. ops-bot please prepare a canary route config draft.

ops-bot: @tom draft route created: https://redwood.internal/routes/kodiak-8b-canary (permissions required).

maria: For quant experiments, include both per-layer calibrated int4 and straight int4. Save both artifacts so we can fallback quickly: `kodiak-8b-int4-calib.v1` and `kodiak-8b-int4-naive.v1`.

sasha: Good call. Also capture logits for the eval set (sanity) so we can run automatic hallucination checks offline.

liam: Perf note: remember to warm KV cache with representative prefixes. Otherwise p95 is misleading. We'll run warmup: `wrk -t8 -c50 --script warmup.lua` on dedicated pool.

maria: Adding that to checklist. Also plan for cross-region fallback: if eu-west capacity drops, route to us-west but mark for privacy owners for private deployments.

tom: How will rollout differ for Private (customer-managed infra)? We need an operator runbook for customers.

maria: For Private: provide an ops-runbook artifact and a canary bundle with precomputed perf profiles + required kernel flags. Template: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kodiak-private-template.md

sasha: Can we add an eval harness tag and an alert in the console for quality regressions? I want a metric like "eval_regressions.v1" so we get immediate regression alerts in slack.

maria: Yup — add to Redwood Console: evaluation hooks -> alert on rolling 1h aggregate exceeding thresholds, channel #eng-ml and #oncall.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for kodiak-8b: 2026-04-03T14:00Z -> initial 1% hosted traffic. Deploy id: dply-7392.

liam: One more: quant-specific perf knobs — enable continuous batching threshold 32 tokens and disable micro-batching for int4 kernels. Config snippet: ```
batching: {min_tokens: 32, micro_batching: false}
kernel_flags: ["int4-opt", "kv-prefetch=on"]
```

maria: Filing follow-ups: 1) sasha QA slot 2) ops-bot route + rollback policy 3) liam perf triage run 4) tom private runbook review. I'll post a final status when PHASE 1 completes.

sasha: :thumbsup: I'll queue the eval job now. ETA 6h.

ops-bot: Eval job queued: job-8845, logs at https://redwood.internal/jobs/job-8845/logs

tom: If anything looks off on rollback triggers, we should do an immediate circuit-breaker and divert to ember21b. Who flips that?

maria: On call will have the emergency toggle. @oncall, please be ready during the 24h canary window.

oncall: Affirmative. I'll monitor metrics and can flip the fallback route if thresholds hit.

maria: Thanks all. I'll update the checklist with links after the evaL run completes.

sasha: minor nit — please add a quick note about seed & RNG determinism for the eval harness so we can reproduce diffs.

maria: Added. End of thread.
